payload.prediction: Perihilar biliary obstruction due to metastatic renal cell carcinoma
payload.report: The patient's markedly elevated ALP and GGT with hilar imaging indicate biliary obstruction. Liver biopsy showing PAX8-positive malignant cells in Glisson's capsule destroying interlobular bile ducts confirms extrahepatic/perihilar obstruction due to metastatic malignancy. PAX8 positivity and axitinib use strongly support renal cell carcinoma metastasis. Unchanged enzymes after stopping alcohol and axitinib exclude drug-induced injury, and biopsy refutes chronic liver disease, immune cholangiopathy, cholangiocarcinoma, inflammatory stricture, and stone obstruction. Pending MRCP/ERCP and serum bilirubin slightly limit certainty, but current evidence establishes perihilar obstruction from metastatic renal cell carcinoma as the leading diagnosis.
